about_the_game:
Loco-Muko – A Nostalgic Brain-Bending Platform Adventure!

Built by a true collector who grew up swapping gum-sticker pics in the schoolyard, Loco-Muko is a delightful mashup of logic, reflexes, and sweet childhood memories. Imagine a world where collectible pictures meet tricky jumps, your brain argues with your fingers, and the platforms aren’t always what they seem. Yeah... it gets weird.

The gameplay? Super simple! Just hop from platform to platform using your arrow keys. Easy, right? Think again. These platforms have minds of their own, and they definitely don’t care what your brain wants. You’ll need sharp reflexes, clever thinking, and a high tolerance for falling off into the void. Repeatedly.

But hey, it’s not all pain and chaos—you’ll also unlock tons of fun illustrations inspired by the legendary Odra gum series. Each level brings new surprises, stories, and a blast of pure, sticker-packed nostalgia. Only the most persistent players will collect them all. Think you're up for it?
